input: Book a professional teeth whitening consultation

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing whether the user already has a dentist or needs to find a new provider entirely changes the first step — searching vs. calling.
The user's location determines which clinics or dental offices are actually reachable and relevant.
Whether there is urgency (e.g., a wedding or event coming up) affects how quickly the appointment needs to be secured and which providers are viable.
Professional whitening varies widely in cost; knowing the budget helps filter between a cosmetic dentist, a dental chain, or a dental school clinic.
The consultation could be just an information-gathering chat, or the user may want to immediately follow up with the whitening treatment — this changes what to ask the provider.
Some users prefer in-chair laser/light treatments, others want take-home trays recommended by a professional — the preference shapes which specialist to seek.
Knowing whether the user wants to book online, by phone, or needs help drafting a message determines the very next concrete action.

gold.taskDescription: The user wants to schedule a professional teeth whitening consultation with a dental provider.

questions.title: Do you have an existing dentist to contact?
questions.description: Establish whether the user already has a dental provider relationship or needs to find and vet a new clinic from scratch.

questions.title: What city or area should the clinic be in?
questions.description: Identify the user's location or preferred area so that only nearby, accessible providers are considered.

questions.title: Is there a specific date you need this done by?
questions.description: Determine whether a deadline or upcoming event creates urgency that should prioritise speed of booking.

questions.title: What is your approximate budget for this consultation?
questions.description: Understand the price range the user is comfortable with to filter between premium cosmetic dentists, dental chains, and budget options like dental schools.

questions.title: Should the consultation lead straight into treatment, or is it purely exploratory?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants to gather information only, or is ready to commit to a whitening treatment immediately after the consultation.

questions.title: Do you prefer in-chair whitening or professional take-home trays?
questions.description: Identify the user's treatment preference so the right type of specialist or clinic is targeted from the start.

questions.title: How do you want to make the booking — online, by phone, or via a message?
questions.description: Determine the user's preferred booking method so the immediate next action can be made as concrete and frictionless as possible.
